verses.text: For the music director. Of David, the servant of the LORD. He sang the words of this song to the LORD when the LORD rescued him from all his enemies and from Saul. He said: I love you, LORD. You are my strength.
The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and the one who rescues me. My God is my rock, where I go for safety. He is my shield, my strong saviour, and my high tower.
I call to the LORD, who deserves praise, and I am saved from my enemies.
The ropes of death were wrapped around me. Floods of evil terrified me.
The ropes of the grave were around me. Traps of death were in front of me.
In my trouble I called to the LORD. I cried to my God for help. From his temple he heard my voice. My cry reached his ears.
Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations of the mountains shook and moved, because he was angry.
Smoke came out of his nose. Burning fire came out of his mouth. Glowing coals blazed from it.
He pulled the skies apart and came down. Dark clouds were under his feet.
He rode on a cherub and flew. He soared on the wings of the wind.
He made darkness his hiding place. Dark rain clouds and thick clouds in the sky were his tent around him.
Out of the brightness around him came his thick clouds, with hailstones and flashes of fire.
The LORD thundered from the sky. The voice of the Most High rang out, with hailstones and flashes of fire.
He shot his arrows and scattered his enemies. He sent great bolts of lightning and threw them into confusion.
Then the bottom of the sea could be seen. The foundations of the earth were uncovered when you warned them, LORD, with a blast of breath from your nose.
He reached down from on high and took hold of me. He pulled me out of deep waters.
He rescued me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me, because they were too strong for me.
They attacked me on the day I was in trouble, but the LORD held me up.
He brought me out into a wide-open place. He rescued me because he was pleased with me.
The LORD has rewarded me because I did what is right. He has paid me back because my hands are clean.
I have kept the ways of the LORD. I have not done evil by turning away from my God.
All his laws are in front of me. I have not turned away from his rules.
I was blameless in front of him. I have kept myself from sin.
So the LORD has rewarded me because I did what is right, because my hands are clean in his eyes.
To those who are faithful, you show that you are faithful. To those who are blameless, you show that you are blameless.
To those who are pure, you show that you are pure. But to those who are crooked, you show that you are clever.
You save people who are humble, but you bring down those whose eyes are proud.
LORD, you keep my lamp burning. My God turns my darkness into light.
With your help I can attack a troop of soldiers. With my God I can jump over a wall.
God's way is perfect. The LORD's word has been tested. He is a shield to everyone who comes to him for safety.
Who is God except the LORD? Who is the rock except our God?
It is God who gives me strength and makes my way perfect.
He makes my feet as sure as the feet of a deer. He helps me stand on high places.
He trains my hands for battle, so my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
You have given me your shield of rescue. Your right hand holds me up. Your gentle care has made me great.
You give me a wide path to walk on, so my feet do not slip.
I chased my enemies and caught them. I did not turn back until they were destroyed.
I struck them down so they could not get up. They fell under my feet.
You gave me strength for battle. You made those who attacked me bow down at my feet.
You made my enemies turn and run, and I destroyed those who hated me.
They cried for help, but there was no one to save them. They cried to the LORD, but he did not answer.
I crushed them as fine as dust blown by the wind. I threw them out like mud in the streets.
You rescued me from people who fought against me. You made me ruler over nations. People I did not know serve me.
As soon as they hear about me, they obey me. Foreigners bow down to me.
Foreigners lose heart and come trembling out of their strong places.
The LORD lives! Praise be to my rock! May God my saviour be honoured!
He is the God who pays back my enemies for me and brings nations under my control.
He rescues me from my enemies. You lift me high above those who attack me. You rescue me from violent people.
So I will thank you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to your name.
He gives his king great victories. He shows faithful love to his anointed king, to David and his descendants forever.
